summary: The implementation correctly satisfies all requirements for T08, including SemVer caret bounds logic and prerelease handling, while preserving legacy signatures.
key_findings: matches_caret correctly implements the upper bound logic for major=0 cases (minor > 0 vs minor == 0).
parse_semver_tag correctly extracts prerelease strings and returns None when absent.
Prerelease versions are rejected by default and accepted only when allow_prerelease=True.
Legacy parse_core_tuple remains unchanged and functional.
